name: csv-import
title: CSV import
description: Brings a CSV file into your records in three steps: upload, map its columns to your fields, review what will be skipped and why.

CsvImportMapping.description: The Map columns step on its own: a line for each required field still missing, and a Table with one row per column (its name, sample values, a "Maps to" Select, Auto-matched). From 520px wide the samples and the badge have their own columns; narrower, they fold under the name. A field picked by a second column shows an error there. Other props, `ref` included, go to its root.

props.name: headers
props.description: The column names (csvHeaders).

props.name: rows
props.description: The data rows, for each column's sample values (the first few that aren't empty).

props.name: autoMapping
props.description: What auto-match picked, for the Auto-matched badges. Defaults to matchColumns(headers, fields).

props.name: header
props.description: Shows "First row is a header" with this value.

props.name: meta
props.description: A line at the start, above the table: "leads.csv · 340 rows".

CsvImportPreview.description: The Review step on its own: "340 rows · 328 ready · 12 with errors", an Alert grouping the errors by field (each group a link that turns on "Show only errors" and moves focus to its first cell), the checkbox, and a Table of the mapped fields, 100 rows a page with Pagination under it. An invalid cell is in the error colour with a warning mark and its reason (a Tooltip, and read out). Other props, `ref` included, go to its root.

props.name: mapping
props.description: Which columns map to which fields: the table shows the mapped fields.

props.name: validation
props.description: validateCsv's result.

props.name: overLimit
props.description: Rows past `maxRows`, in the summary.

CsvImportProgress.description: "Importing 120 of 328…" over a Progress bar. Other props, `ref` included, go to its root.

props.name: done
props.description: Rows done.

props.name: total
props.description: Rows to import.

CsvImportResult.description: The outcome of an import as a table: a heading that says it ("328 leads imported · 12 skipped", the focus target, `data-csv-focus="result"`), a SegmentedControl of Imported and Skipped (and Not imported when a run stopped), "Download skipped rows" (a CSV with an `error` column; icon-only under 420px), and the segment's rows, 100 a page. Imported and Not imported show the normalised values sent; Skipped shows a Reason column and the source values, invalid cells marked as in the preview. An empty segment says why inside the table body. A stopped run adds a warning Alert with "Retry from row 121"; when nothing was saved, the empty Imported table carries the reason and Retry instead. Other props, `ref` included, go to its root.

props.name: mapping
props.description: Which columns map to which fields: the tables show the mapped fields.

props.name: validation
props.description: validateCsv's result.

props.name: imported
props.description: Valid rows saved: the first `imported` of them, in file order (onProgress counts them in order).

props.name: status
props.description: `stopped` when the run failed or was cancelled before the last row: adds Not imported.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why a stopped run stopped (the rejected promise's message). Without it, it was cancelled.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Adds Retry to a stopped result: "Retry from row 121", or Retry in the empty table when nothing was saved.

props.name: overLimit
props.description: Rows past `maxRows`: a muted line under the heading.

props.name: noun
props.description: "lead" / "leads". Defaults to the `csvRowNoun` label.

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: Defaults to `imported`.

props.name: headers
props.description: The file's column names, for the skipped rows file (csvHeaders). Defaults to "Column 1"…

props.name: fileName
props.description: The file's name: the skipped rows file is `<name>-skipped.csv`.

props.name: delimiter
props.description: The skipped rows file's delimiter: the source file's (CsvParseResult.delimiter).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables Retry.

props.name: onImport
props.type: (rows: Record<string, string>[], ctx: CsvImportContext) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Gets only the valid rows, keyed by field, normalised (text trimmed, an enum as its option's value, a number as "1234.5", a date as yyyy-mm-dd), once Import is pressed. Report progress with `onProgress` and honour `signal` for Cancel. A rejected promise shows its message with Retry in the result; void or a resolved promise is done. Retry resumes: it calls `onImport` again with only the rows after the last `onProgress(done)` count, so report a row done once it is saved. `onProgress` in that call counts from 0 again; the panel adds what was done before.

props.name: noun
props.description: "lead" / "leads": used in "Import 328 leads". Defaults to the `csvRowNoun` label.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Data rows to import at most. Rows past it are counted and reported, never imported.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest file, in bytes.

props.name: templateHref
props.description: A template CSV to download, linked under the drop zone.

props.name: defaultStep
props.description: Start on `map` with a `file` to skip Upload.

props.name: defaultMapping
props.description: Wins over auto-match for its columns.

props.name: onMappingChange
props.description: Called with each change, and with the auto-matched mapping when a new file is read.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Adds Done to the footer of the result.

props.name: cancelable
props.description: Shows Cancel while importing: `onImport` honours its `signal`.
